title: Een Mo Ment Nu, Willum Geerts
excerpt: Video and projections for MoMentNu, an immersive light installation with artist Willum Geerts.
description:
MoMentNu is an installation at Museum Jan Cunen in Oss, based on a concept by artist Willum Geerts. The imagery came from aerial LiDAR point clouds of the city of Oss, which I rendered in Cinema 4D. It is part of the long-running point-cloud research that also carries Panorama Utrecht, LiDAR Utrecht and Points of Light: scanning a place, then finding out what it becomes once it is only data and light. Horizontal bands of moving light are wrapped around the wooden beams and pillars of the space, turning the architecture itself into a slow, drifting landscape of projected image.
> Visitors move through the darkened room as the projections shift around them, blurring the line between the building and the picture. A quiet, immersive meditation on the present moment.
credits: Concept: Willum Geerts. Realisation, video & projections: Jaco Schilp / Studio Schilp. Content built from aerial LiDAR point-cloud data of Oss, rendered in Cinema 4D. Presented at Museum Jan Cunen, Oss.
